articles.title: Trump, Xi Hug Ahead of Unprecedented Talks with Russia’s Putin
articles.description: In a rare move, Chinese President Xi Jinping greeted US President Donald Trump with a hug on arrival in Shenzhen, ahead of an unprecedented trilateral meeting between the two leaders and Russian President Vladimir Putin. Before Trump’s arrival, Xi warned against economic barriers and urged closer cooperation among Asia-Pacific nations, as new US restrictions on China’s access to advanced AI chips strain a fragile trade truce. Nvidia sought to deliver a clear message during its first earnings update since the departure of longtime leader Jensen Huang. The chip giant boosted its sales forecast for next year and vowed to improve Nvidia’s access to critical supplies, while tamping down speculation that Huang might return. Today’s guests: Michael Strobaek, Lombard Odier Global Chief Investment Officer; Melanie Garson, University College London Associate Professor; David Kirtley, Helion Energy Founder & CEO (Source: Bloomberg)
